sermon.title: Jesus Teaches When, How, and Why to Not Resist Evil — July 24, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Session nine: Jesus’ “do not resist evil” is not about criminals, who must be punished, but about stopping fights before they start. Love enemies by doing good, blessing and praying; be merciful as the Father is—and still do justly and speak up.
